about: Quotes from works the index does not hold, attested by a cited source. The quote is the common wording, kept short to identify it. Reviewed 2026-10-25.

attested.quote: Every minute could be an eternity of happiness.
attested.finding: From Dostoevsky's letter to his brother Mikhail of 22 December 1849, written after the mock execution; translations vary ("each minute might have been an age of happiness"). The 1914 English edition in the index abridges this letter.
